_about: Studio-wide experiment register (J3257, Ben 20 Nov 2026). Driven by scripts/channels.py. Max 3 live (running) experiments per channel at once so effects stay attributable. Managed by scripts/rsi.py.

experiments.hypothesis: Tighter Short opening cuts (Cut 1 <= 2.8 s, Cut 2 <= 4.8 s, zero CTA/end card, loop tail < 1.2 s) raise stayed-to-watch toward 60% and average % viewed above 70%.
experiments.change: Apply OWB-2026-11-E1 timing and zero-CTA rules to eligible scheduled-private 026-029 Shorts and new 030+ cuts.
experiments.evidence: Approved timing experiment (Chief h47, J2207, 6 Nov 2026). Readout 3 Dec 2026.
experiments.revert_plan: Restore prior OWB Short timing/outro defaults in studio/RULES.md and Short cut templates.

experiments.hypothesis: A 58-minute calm journey documentary stitched from finished films with new linking VO earns browse and search watch time above single-question longs.
experiments.change: Publish Journey film (OWB:J01, 58 min) on 8 Dec 2026 and measure 14-day views, impressions and CTR against the 230-view baseline.
experiments.expected_effect: >= 500 views in 14 days keeps format; 230-499 runs one more; < 230 drops/changes
experiments.evidence: Ben OK 14 Nov 2026 (J2864). Baseline: 16 Orbit longs averaged 2% CTR, best 230 views.
experiments.revert_plan: Do not schedule further monthly journey films if 14-day views fall below 230.

experiments.hypothesis: A complete-tour numbered explainer ('Every planet explained in 10 minutes') earns search and browse impressions on a small channel far above single-question longs.
experiments.change: Publish Every planet explained in 10 minutes (OWB:064) on 16 Dec 2026 and score 14-day views against the 500-view bar.
experiments.expected_effect: >= 500 views in 14 days keeps format; 230-499 runs one more; < 230 drops/changes
experiments.evidence: Ben locked OWB:064 on 17 Nov 2026 (J2863/J3011). Baseline best long: 230 views.
experiments.revert_plan: Drop the 'Every X Explained in 10 Minutes' format if 14-day views fall below 230.

experiments.hypothesis: A 1h 48m slow space documentary for sleep, titled and tagged from search research, earns sustained bedtime search and browse views.
experiments.change: Publish Sleep film on 12 Dec 2026 and score 14-day views against the 500-view bar (activates into next open OWB slot after EXP-OWB-001 reads out on 3 Dec).
experiments.expected_effect: >= 500 views in 14 days keeps format; < 230 drops/changes
experiments.evidence: Ben OK 14 Nov 2026 (J2859/J2860/J2861). Queued behind 3-experiment live cap until 3 Dec readout.
experiments.revert_plan: Do not build a second sleep documentary if 14-day views fall below 230.

experiments.hypothesis: Returning to the July illustrated style with the Orbit mascot on a search-led long lifts CTR and retention over photoreal-only longs.
experiments.change: Build the first January search-led long (Sun 10 Jan 2027) in the July illustrated style with the Orbit mascot.
experiments.metric: 14-day views, impressions CTR (%) and average % viewed
experiments.expected_effect: >= 500 views in 14 days keeps illustrated style; < 230 drops it
experiments.evidence: Ben OK 20 Nov 2026: first January long uses the July illustrated style with Orbit mascot as a style test.
experiments.revert_plan: Stay with photoreal documentary style for subsequent January longs if 14-day views < 230.

experiments.hypothesis: One weekly dated-event Short tied to a real sky/space date (published 3-7 days prior) achieves >= 2x median 7-day Short views.
experiments.change: Run weekly dated-event Shorts (backlog item owb-dated-short, AR cohort J1356) and measure 7-day views on the first 4.
experiments.metric: 7-day views vs channel median Short views (118)
experiments.expected_effect: >= 2 of first 4 reach >= 2x median Short views at 7 days
experiments.evidence: Apophis Short gJwNJN_yMKU hit 233% avg viewed and 214k FB Reel views.
experiments.revert_plan: Pause owb-dated-short backlog item if fewer than 2 of 4 hit 2x median.

experiments.hypothesis: Setting each Short's Related video to its parent long within 1 h of go-public day doubles subscribers per 1,000 Short views.
experiments.change: Link 025 Mars and 026 Nearest Star Shorts to their parent longs on go-public day and read 14-day sub conversion.
experiments.metric: subscribers per 1,000 Short views and long views from Shorts
experiments.expected_effect: >= 1.4 subs per 1,000 Short views (2x October 0.7 baseline)
experiments.evidence: OWB October baseline: 5 subs on 6,830 views (0.7 per 1,000).
experiments.revert_plan: Keep Related links as hygiene only and test stronger end-question CTAs if sub rate stays flat.

experiments.hypothesis: Including one bright high-contrast background and one clean real-spacecraft thumbnail variant in each 3-way Test & Compare beats the dark house template.
experiments.change: Test bright-background and single clean real-image thumbnail arms in Test & Compare on new OWB longs (031, 032).
experiments.metric: Test & Compare watch-time share and impressions CTR (%)
experiments.expected_effect: 2 wins promote concept to THUMBNAIL_AND_TITLE_RULES.md; 2 losses retire it
experiments.evidence: Audit 29 Oct: 18 tests with similar dark templates produced 0 winners.
experiments.revert_plan: Retire losing thumbnail arm concept in THUMBNAIL_AND_TITLE_RULES.md.

experiments.hypothesis: Shorts about phenomena viewers have seen from the ground (shooting stars, sunrises, eclipses, ISS) outperform distant-planet facts on stayed-to-watch and views.
experiments.change: Readout-only comparison on scheduled ground-visible Shorts Dm4xsF1Ateg (23 Nov), xdurJQcoiGM (25 Nov), MScK2CK2ZFg (28 Nov).
experiments.expected_effect: beat OWB median stayed-to-watch (32.5%) on >= 2 of 3 Shorts
experiments.evidence: T9fVlG3CCzU (1,282 views, 49.8% stayed) and VfDm3E2bUgU (1,090 views) led planet-fact Shorts.
experiments.revert_plan: Drop ground-visible topic preference if fewer than 2 of 3 beat median.

experiments.hypothesis: Spacing same-subject Shorts so no third Short in a row runs on the same subject prevents Shorts-feed suppression.
experiments.change: Forbid scheduling a third Short in a row on the same subject; require >= 1 different-subject Short between them (>= 2 when the earlier Short stayed below 32.5%).
experiments.expected_effect: third consecutive same-subject Short drops off feed while spaced Shorts retain feed distribution
experiments.evidence: Mars run (1,074 -> 110 -> 57, then spaced helicopter 1,263) and Nearest-star run (469 -> 268 -> 16 at 21h, only 3 feed views). Promoted to Rule 35 on 19 Nov 2026 (J3121).
experiments.revert_plan: Remove Rule 35 spacing constraint from LEARNINGS.md and scheduling checks if feed behaviour changes.
experiments.changelog: Kept: promoted same-subject Shorts spacing to Rule 35 (no third Short in a row on the same subject).

experiments.hypothesis: Expanding HOS from 3 to 4 Shorts/week with a Saturday 11:30 go-public-day Short pointing at Thursday's long grows weekly reach and long-form conversions.
experiments.change: Run 4 Shorts/week (Sat/Sun/Tue/Fri 11:30 London) on HOS 006 and 007 with SHORTS_CONTENT_LINKS pointed at the parent long.
experiments.metric: weekly Shorts views and SHORTS_CONTENT_LINKS conversions to parent longs
experiments.expected_effect: sustained Shorts feed reach without cannibalisation and >= 2 long-form conversions
experiments.evidence: Ben OK 7 Nov 2026. First 2 HOS long-form conversions recorded on 7 Nov snapshot.
experiments.revert_plan: Return HOS cadence to 3 Shorts/week in history-of-science studio/channel.json if views/short drop.

experiments.hypothesis: Proof-first first 30 seconds (cuts < 4.5 s, >= 7 moving plates, apparatus/proof in 0:05-0:15, DATA+SCALE in 0:25-0:40) lifts HOS long 0:30 retention to >= 60% and 14d avg % viewed to >= 22%.
experiments.change: Apply HOS-2026-11-E2 proof-first first-30s picture/edit rules to HOS longs 008, 009 and 010.
experiments.metric: 0:30 retention (%) and days 0-13 average % viewed (at >= 100 Studio views)
experiments.evidence: Chief h47 approved 5 Nov 2026. Baseline: HOS 004 30% at 0:30, HOS 002 56% at 0:30.
experiments.revert_plan: Remove E2 cut-pace requirement from HOS picture-plan template and AGENTS.md if 0:30 drops below 40%.

experiments.hypothesis: Making 4 of 4 HOS Short titles per film direct curriculum/phenomenon search questions (never statements) raises stayed-to-watch and search compounding.
experiments.change: Tighten Rule 28 from 2/4 to 4/4 search-question Short titles across HOS 005, 007 and 008 Shorts.
experiments.expected_effect: raise median HOS Short stayed-to-watch above 40% and maintain >= 20% search share
experiments.evidence: Chief OK J2833, 15 Nov 2026. -3L6HzJ_d_4 hit 77.1% stayed and 92.9% search vs statement PFj6172YU4Q 15.98% stayed.
experiments.revert_plan: Restore 2/4 search-question mix in HOS THUMBNAIL_AND_TITLE_RULES.md if 4/4 underperforms.
